text:
Ethan: quick flag  found a broken redirect in the SDK examples page and an out-of-date curl snippet that fails against staging. can someone eyeball?

Maya: thanks for the heads-up. which page exactly? i can do a quick patch if it's small.

Ethan: /kb/sdk/getting-started.md -> example link points to /api/v1/old-gen which 301s to the new endpoint and breaks the sample response parsing. also the curl example uses header `X-Old-Auth` instead of `Authorization`.

Priya S.: oof. that header mismatch explains the failing smoke test i've been seeing in the quickstart job. want me to open a tiny PR to update the curl and link?

Ethan: please yes. the sample response parsing code block also has a trailing comma in the JSON which causes lint fail in the docs pipeline.

Maya: i'll take the redirect + sample body fix. Priya, can you update the curl header? i'll add a changelog note.

docs-bot: created issue #2191 for sdk quickstart sample fixes (https://go/repo/issues/2191). auto-assigned to docs-triage.

Priya S.: quick patch plan: 1) replace `/api/v1/old-gen` with `/v1/generate` 2) update curl to `-H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"` 3) remove trailing comma in response snippet. i'll include unit test update for the sample smoke check.

Maya: SGTM. tag the PR `docs:sdk-fix`. i'll request review from @ethan.

build-bot: docs build triggered for PR #2358 — smoke tests failing: curl example still failing on staging (401).

Priya S.: checking env creds used by the smoke runner. might be a staging token rotation. pinging eng-infra in parallel.

Ethan: if infra rotated token, we should avoid baking tokens. can the smoke test use an unsettable mock endpoint instead?

Maya: good call. we can mock the network for the sample check or use `--dry-run` variant. i'll open a follow-up GH issue if changing test harness is needed.

Priya S.: PR posted: https://go/repo/pulls/2358  updates curl header, fixes link, removes trailing comma, and adjusts smoke test to skip live auth when `DOCS_SMOKE_OFFLINE=true`. PTAL.

Ethan: looking now. small nit: update the inline note about endpoint deprecation date. after that LGTM.

Priya S.: updated the note. thanks. merging after CI passes. will follow up if infra token issue needs ops escalation. :thumbsup:
